question: How should the practitioner wash the body with consecrated waters?
premises: Impurity is removed using clay consecrated by the weapon mantra.
Waters are consecrated by the five-limb mantras.
The body is washed in order from head to feet.
inference: After removing impurity with consecrated clay, the practitioner should sequentially wash the body from head to feet with waters empowered by the five-limb mantras.
plain_english: Having removed impurity with clay consecrated by the weapon mantra, one should then wash the body in order from head to feet with waters consecrated by the five-limb mantras.
